_about: Documented output lines of docs/tutorials that are known to differ from what the code prints now (scripts/run_tutorials.py). They are reported as known drift, as warnings, and do not fail the run; any other difference does. An entry matches a documented line that starts with `line` (whitespace collapsed). Remove an entry when the tutorial is fixed: an entry that matches nothing is reported (warning, or an error with --strict-known). `since`: the commit that changed the output.
